scope: Current v2rayN GUI, all logical SQLite tables, primary config.json core, and all xray TCP listeners
jsonCanonicalization: Python JSON values; sort object keys, preserve array order and scalar types, reject duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers; no omitted fields

B.protectedDatabaseFields: ALL_TABLES_ALL_COLUMNS_ALL_ROWS_PLUS_SCHEMA; transactionally consistent read-only snapshot; duplicate rows retained
B.rawDbHashLimit: Audit file bytes are not a substitute for the logical transaction snapshot; no DB backup/export is produced

C.reason: Generation is established, but benign byte-changing regeneration of this exact runtime config has not been proven

D.reason: Diagnostic application logs, not source or effective configuration. No cache/config/state directory is broadly exempted.

allowedBenignDifferences: JSON object key ordering and whitespace in class B only, with identical complete parsed values
SQLite physical layout or row enumeration order with identical complete logical table contents and schema
File mtime/inode replacement with identical protected content; metadata remains recorded
neverExempt: unknown fields or new SQLite tables
